title: Copper-promoted oxidative mono- and di-bromination of 8-aminoquinoline amides with HBr and DMSO
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,8750-8756
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00492F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Changdong Shao, Jingyi Liu, Yanan Shen, Li Li, Chen Ma, Zhengsong Hu, Yuhe Kan, Ping Chen, Tingting Zhang
An efficient and convenient protocol for copper-promoted oxidative mono- and di-bromination of 8-aminoquinoline amides using hydrogen bromide (HBr) as the brominating reagent and dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO) as a mild oxidant has been developed.
